'''Igor Moiseevich Krichever''' ({{langx|ru|Игорь Моисеевич Кричевер}}; 8 October 1950 – 1 December 2022) was a Russian academic and mathematician.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.hse.ru/data/2013/11/18/1277507672/CV%20%D0%9A%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%B5%D1%80.pdf|title=Curriculum Vitae|work=Higher School of Economics|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20190115132533/https://www.hse.ru/data/2013/11/18/1277507672/CV%20%D0%9A%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B5%D0%B2%D0%B5%D1%80.pdf|archivedate=15 January 2019}}</ref>

==Biography==
Krichever was born in [[Samara|Kuybyshev]] to aviation engineer Moisey Solomonovich Krichever<ref>{{cite web|url=https://poisk.re/awards/1535538845|title=Награда Моисея Кричевера|work=poisk.re|language=Russian}}</ref> and Maria Leyzerovna Arlievskaya.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mathnet.ru/php/archive.phtml?wshow=paper&jrnid=rm&paperid=10015&option_lang=rus|title=Игорь Моисеевич Кричевер (к семидесятилетию со дня рождения)|work=Math-Net.ru|language=Russian}}</ref> He received a silver medal at the 1967 [[International Mathematical Olympiad]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.imo-official.org/participant_r.aspx?id=10052|title=Igor Krichever|work=International Mathematical Olympiad|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180304054915/https://www.imo-official.org/participant_r.aspx?id=10052|archivedate=4 March 2018}}</ref> He graduated from the [[MSU Faculty of Mechanics and Mathematics]] in 1972.

From 1975 to 1988, Krichever was a researcher at the {{ill|Energy Institute G. M. Krzhizhanovsky|ru|Энергетический институт имени Г. М. Кржижановского}}. He was then a senior researcher at the {{ill|Institute for Problems in Mechanics of the Russian Academy of Sciences|ru|Институт проблем механики имени А. Ю. Ишлинского РАН}}. In 1990, he became a senior researcher for the [[Landau Institute for Theoretical Physics]]. From 1992 to 1996, he was a professor at the [[Independent University of Moscow]]. In 1997, he became a professor at [[Columbia University]] in [[New York City]], where he served as dean of the mathematics department from 2008 to 2011.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://mozzochi.org/Krichever/Photos.html|title=Conference in honor of 60th Birthday of Igor Krichever Columbia University, May 4-7, 2011.|work=C. J. Mozzochi}}</ref> In 2013, he became a professor at the [[Higher School of Economics]] in [[Moscow]]. That same year, he became deputy director of the {{ill|Institute for Information Transmission Problems of Russian Academy of Sciences|ru|Институт проблем передачи информации имени А. А. Харкевича РАН}}.

In 2011, Krichever was awarded the [[Medal of the Order "For Merit to the Fatherland"]] II class.

Igor Krichever died in New York City on 1 December 2022, at the age of 72.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=2 December 2022|title=Игорь Моисеевич Кричевер|trans-title= |url=https://math.hse.ru/news/799880385.html|language=Russian|work=[[Higher School of Economics]]|location= |access-date=5 December 2022}}</ref>
